author: FayeSpica
body:
Could we add a small performance comparison before deciding on the approach? Ideally covering all three paths on real Qwen3-TTS shapes:

1. BNSD fused (npu_rotary_mul, the supported-shape fast path)
2. BSND fused (transpose + .contiguous() fallback, as in this PR)
3. plain-torch (q*cos + rotate_half(q)*sin, no fused op)

author: FayeSpica
body: I think this should become a model-independent NPU rotary op rather than living in a per-model tokenizer patch: extract it into a shared util.

author: gxxx-hum
body:
Thanks for the suggestion. To clarify, This is primarily a correctness fix. With codec_chunk_ramp enabled, the BNSD path crashes on real Code2Wav workloads at concurrency 4 or higher, so it is not a valid performance baseline for the failing shapes. This patch keeps BNSD for supported shapes and only falls back to BSND when necessary. 
Without codec_chunk_ramp, streaming audio has obvious discontinuities and significant underrun time, making it unsuitable for production use.

author: gxxx-hum
body: Thanks, I extracted the BNSD shape check and BSND fallback into a shared, model-independent NPU rotary helper.
